summary.title: HelixPay - Steal customer payment data
summary.description: How could HelixPay have a customer payment-data breach? Diagram 1 is the team's attack tree (goal = steal customer payment data; AND/OR branches). Diagram 2 maps the same attack paths onto the system with STRIDE threats and mitigations.

data.name: Customer
data.description: Card holder using HelixPay

threats.title: Customer phished for card data / credentials
threats.description: Lookalike sites, SMS or email lure customers into entering card details or app credentials.
threats.mitigation: Customer awareness messaging, DMARC/BIMI on email domains, brand-domain takedown service, step-up auth for new devices.

data.name: Customer app (web + mobile)
data.description: Checkout and account UI running on the customer's device

threats.title: Client-side skimming via XSS or third-party script
threats.description: Injected JavaScript on the checkout page captures card numbers as they are typed (Magecart-style). Whiteboard: XSS.
threats.mitigation: Output encoding, strict Content-Security-Policy, Subresource Integrity, script inventory and change detection (PCI DSS 6.4.3 / 11.6.1), hosted payment fields / iframe tokenisation.

data.name: Administrators (16 accounts)
data.description: Ops, DB and cloud admins

threats.title: Admin account takeover via AiTM phishing + weak MFA
threats.description: Phishing AND weak MFA AND MITM: adversary-in-the-middle kit steals session cookie, or MFA push fatigue gets a prompt accepted. 16 standing admin accounts multiply the targets.
threats.mitigation: Phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2/passkeys), number matching, cut standing admins via just-in-time PAM, conditional access, session binding.

threats.title: Malicious or careless insider
threats.description: An admin abuses or mishandles standing access to the cardholder DB.
threats.mitigation: Least privilege, dual control for CDE access, session recording, bulk-read alerting.

data.name: API gateway
data.description: Single public entry point

threats.title: Broken object-level authorisation (BOLA)
threats.description: Changing an object ID in an API call returns another customer's data or payment methods.
threats.mitigation: Object-level authorisation checks in every service, API security testing (OWASP API Top 10), schema validation at the gateway.

threats.title: Credential stuffing against customer login
threats.description: Reused passwords tried at scale to take over customer accounts.
threats.mitigation: Rate limiting, bot detection, breached-password checks, customer MFA / passkeys.

data.name: Staging / API server
data.description: Pre-production environment, exposed to the internet

threats.title: Exposed staging server with production data or shared secrets
threats.description: Staging is internet-reachable, less hardened, and may hold copied production card data or the same credentials as prod; foothold for lateral movement.
threats.mitigation: Remove public exposure (VPN/allow-list), synthetic or tokenised test data only, separate AWS accounts and secrets per environment.

data.name: Microservices
data.description: Orders, users, notifications

threats.title: Lateral movement through implicit service trust
threats.description: Flat network and no service-to-service auth let an attacker on any service reach the cardholder DB.
threats.mitigation: Network segmentation / security groups, mTLS with service identity, per-service DB credentials with least privilege.

data.name: Payment server (Java)
data.description: Authorises payments with the acquirer

threats.title: Log4Shell remote code execution
threats.description: Unpatched Log4j (CVE-2021-44228) lets an attacker run code on the payment server via a crafted string in any logged field.
threats.mitigation: Patch Log4j >= 2.17.1, SBOM + dependency scanning, WAF virtual patch, block outbound LDAP/JNDI egress.

threats.title: Card data scraped from memory or logs
threats.description: With code execution, PANs in memory or accidentally logged are harvested directly - DB access is not needed.
threats.mitigation: Never log PAN, mask in logs, tokenise as early as possible, file-integrity and EDR monitoring.

data.name: Identity provider + MFA
data.description: Admin and staff authentication

threats.title: MFA bypass
threats.description: SMS/OTP/push MFA is phishable and fatigue-prone.
threats.mitigation: Enforce FIDO2/WebAuthn for all privileged users; disable SMS fallback.

data.name: Jenkins CI/CD
data.description: Builds and deploys all services; holds deploy secrets

threats.title: Pipeline compromise / secrets theft
threats.description: Exposed Jenkins or weak auth lets an attacker steal stored credentials or push a backdoored build to the payment server (privilege escalation).
threats.mitigation: Private network only, SSO + MFA, secrets in a vault with short-lived tokens, signed builds, plugin hygiene, least-privilege deploy roles.

data.name: Cardholder database
data.description: PAN, expiry, customer PII - crown jewel

threats.title: Bulk exfiltration of card data
threats.description: Any path that reaches DB access (admin, lateral movement, staging, cloud exposure) can dump stored PANs; damage depends on whether data is tokenised/encrypted.
threats.mitigation: Tokenise or encrypt PAN with KMS/HSM-held keys, column-level access, no CVV storage, egress controls.

threats.title: Undetected bulk reads
threats.description: Weak logging means a dump is not noticed or attributable.
threats.mitigation: DB activity monitoring, alerts on bulk SELECTs, immutable logs, CloudTrail + GuardDuty.

data.name: Backups & snapshots (S3 / RDS)
data.description: DB backups, snapshots, exports

threats.title: Public bucket or snapshot exposes card data
threats.description: Security misconfiguration makes AWS storage or the DB security group publicly reachable.
threats.mitigation: S3 Block Public Access at account level, encrypted private snapshots, AWS Config / CSPM rules, IaC scanning.

data.name: Acquirer / card network
data.description: External payment processor

threats.title: Interception on internal hop
threats.description: If TLS terminates at the gateway, PANs cross the VPC in clear.
threats.mitigation: TLS/mTLS end to end inside the VPC.

threats.title: Staging path into production data
threats.description: Shared credentials or data sync give the exposed staging server a route to the CDE.
threats.mitigation: No network path from staging to prod; separate credentials.

threats.title: Session cookie theft (AiTM)
threats.description: Reverse-proxy phishing captures the authenticated session.
threats.mitigation: FIDO2, token binding, short sessions, impossible-travel alerts.
